cli_args.text: Generate ONE game UI asset: wide horizontal room lobby panel FRAME ONLY for mobile landscape casual fantasy board game. Ornate polished silver-white metal border with gold filigree corners and small blue gems, crisp beveled detail. CRITICAL: inner area ~75% of canvas must be FULLY TRANSPARENT alpha=0 — only border ring, NO opaque center fill. Border thickness ~52px. No text, no player cards, no buttons. PNG with alpha channel.
